translated_text: Mind precedes all mental states. Mind is their chief; they are all mind-wrought. If with an impure mind a person speaks or acts, suffering follows him like the wheel that follows the foot of the ox.
original_text: Mano pubbaṅgamā dhammā, mano seṭṭhā, manomayā;

translated_text: Mind precedes all mental states. Mind is their chief; they are all mind-wrought. If with a pure mind a person speaks or acts, happiness follows him like his never-departing shadow.
original_text: Mano pubbaṅgamā dhammā, mano seṭṭhā, manomayā;

translated_text: "He abused me, he struck me, he overpowered me, he robbed me." Those who harbor such thoughts do not still their hatred.
original_text: Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ, ajini maṃ ahāsi me;

translated_text: "He abused me, he struck me, he overpowered me, he robbed me." Those who do not harbor such thoughts still their hatred.
original_text: Akkocchi maṃ avadhi maṃ, ajini maṃ ahāsi me;

translated_text: Hatred is never appeased by hatred in this world; by non-hatred alone is hatred appeased. This is a law eternal.
original_text: Na hi verena verāni, sammantīdha kudācanaṃ;
